In the new-leaf row, G_zj=εG_3j/(μ+ε) for j≠z, so the new-new cross entries are O(ε²); the leading new-leaf variance gap is 4(ε/μ)² times H_3, independently verified as 223184259/190905800>0. value.rationale: A proper bipartition is a natural low-cost default for trace probing on a tree; strict stability under both readily interpretable neighborhoods makes it a genuine obstruction to improving that default by either move family, rather than merely a bad coloring. The rigorous window and growth construction rule out an isolated numerical tie or fixed-order anomaly. The claim is existential, not a claim about minimal witness size, typicality, or all refinement heuristics.
